headline: Cable and wire stocks including Polycab and KEI Industries drop up to 5%
summary: Shares of cable and wire manufacturers Polycab, KEI Industries, R R Kabel, and Quadrant Future Tek declined by up to 5 percent on Tuesday. These stocks are currently down as much as 24 percent from their 52-week highs reached in September. The correction reflects a broader cooling in momentum for these industrial counters. Indian retail investors holding exposure to electrical and infrastructure themes face near-term consolidation in these shares.
why_it_matters: Cable stocks consolidate after hitting recent record highs
